title: Accountability of Food Delivery and Courier Service Companies for Work-related Traffic Accidents
what_it_is: Accountability of Food Delivery and Courier Service Companies for Work-related Traffic Accidents

sections.label: Delivery company WSH infringements
sections.summary: Over 70% of infringements involved inadequate risk assessment; companies have since rectified lapses, and similar operations will target other delivery companies and couriers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: More than 70% of the infringements were related to the lack of or inadequate risk assessment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: These companies did not conduct risk assessment to identify hazards which can affect the safety and health of their employees and contract personnel.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Without risk assessments, the companies are not able to put in place the necessary preventive actions against accidents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: These errant companies have since rectified the safety lapses and conducted proper risk assessments for their employees and contracted parties directly working under them.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We will conduct similar operations this year on other delivery companies and couriers to ensure that they also adopt proper WSH measures at their workplaces.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: On the need for legislation, the Workplace Safety and Health Act (WSHA) already requires food delivery and courier service companies to ensure the safety and health of their workers, including part-time employees and contract personnel.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Will MOM consider making it mandatory for our employers to buy special insurance policies for their delivery men to cover third-party risks so that the victims can make claims should there be an accident?

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: However, there is one group of delivery men not covered under the current law and these are the delivery men using personal mobility devices to perform their tasks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: This issue is being studied by the Active Mobility Advisory Panel under MOT.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: I understand that the study is due to be completed by the end of this year.
